mapper.select: SELECT ast30_corp_id AS corp_id , sys15_corp_cd AS corp_code , sys15_corp_nm AS corp_name , SUM(ast30_diff_fee) AS diff_fee , SUM(ast30_fee) AS fee , SUM(ast30_un_rcv_fee) AS un_rcv_fee , SUM(ast30_fix_fee) AS fix_fee , SUM(ast30_fee - ast30_fix_fee) AS ty_fee FROM ( SELECT * , COALESCE(( SELECT SUM( f_calc_dual_fund_fee(icam10_company_id, icam10_icam_company_cd, icam10_fund_cd, icam10_std_date, icam10_fee) * CASE WHEN icam10_drcr_type = 'C' THEN 1 ELSE -1 END * COALESCE(icam10_fx_rate,1) ) FROM icam10_fee WHERE icam10_company_id = ast30_company_id AND icam10_std_date = ast30_hold_date AND icam10_icam_company_cd = sys15_corp_cd AND icam10_fund_cd = ast30_fund_cd ),0) AS ast30_diff_fee FROM ast30_book_fund_fee INNER JOIN sys15_corp ON sys15_corp_id = ast30_corp_id WHERE ast30_company_id = #{p.companyId} AND ast30_hold_date = #{p.holdDate} AND upper(concat(sys15_corp_cd,sys15_corp_nm,ast30_fund_cd,ast30_fund_nm)) LIKE '%'||upper(#{p.searchText})||'%' ) t GROUP BY ast30_corp_id, sys15_corp_cd, sys15_corp_nm ORDER BY sys15_corp_cd

SELECT ast30_book_fund_fee_id AS book_fund_fee_id , ast30_corp_id AS corp_id , ast30_hold_date AS hold_date , ast30_fund_cd AS fund_code , ast30_fund_nm AS fund_name , ast30_cur_cd AS cur_code , ast30_diff_fee AS diff_fee , ast30_fee AS fee , ast30_un_rcv_fee AS un_rcv_fee , ast30_ty_fee AS ty_fee , ast30_fix_fee AS fix_fee , ast30_for_diff_fee AS for_diff_fee , CASE WHEN ast30_cur_cd = 'KRW' THEN null ELSE ast30_for_fee END AS for_fee , CASE WHEN ast30_cur_cd = 'KRW' THEN null ELSE ast30_for_un_rcv_fee END AS for_un_rcv_fee FROM ( SELECT * , sys15_corp_cd AS ast30_corp_cd , sys15_corp_nm AS ast30_corp_nm , ast30_fee - COALESCE(ast30_fix_fee ,0) AS ast30_ty_fee , COALESCE(( SELECT SUM( f_calc_dual_fund_fee(icam10_company_id, icam10_icam_company_cd, icam10_fund_cd, icam10_std_date, icam10_fee) * CASE WHEN icam10_drcr_type = 'C' THEN 1 ELSE -1 END * COALESCE(icam10_fx_rate,1) ) FROM icam10_fee WHERE icam10_company_id = ast30_company_id AND icam10_std_date = ast30_hold_date AND icam10_icam_company_cd = sys15_corp_cd AND icam10_fund_cd = ast30_fund_cd ),0) AS ast30_diff_fee , CASE WHEN ast30_cur_cd = 'KRW' THEN null ELSE COALESCE(( SELECT SUM(icam10_fee * CASE WHEN icam10_drcr_type = 'C' THEN 1 ELSE -1 END) FROM icam10_fee WHERE icam10_company_id = ast30_company_id AND icam10_std_date = ast30_hold_date AND icam10_icam_company_cd = sys15_corp_cd AND icam10_fund_cd = ast30_fund_cd ),0) END AS ast30_for_diff_fee FROM ast30_book_fund_fee INNER JOIN sys15_corp ON sys15_corp_id = ast30_corp_id WHERE ast30_company_id = #{p.companyId} AND ast30_hold_date = #{p.holdDate} AND ast30_corp_id = #{p.corpId} ) t WHERE upper(concat(sys15_corp_cd,ast30_corp_nm,ast30_fund_cd,ast30_fund_nm)) LIKE '%'||upper(#{p.searchText})||'%' ORDER BY ast30_fund_cd
